# CEO Business Balance

> Calm, shame-free financial mentoring for service-based solopreneurs — so you know where your money is going, whether you're actually profitable, and how to pay yourself without guessing.

Founded by Stacy Luft, MBA. 30+ years in financial operations and cash flow management. Former bookkeeping instructor at Hofstra University.

CEO Business Balance is not accounting software. It is human-led financial mentoring and done-for-you bookkeeping for solopreneurs who have tried to manage their finances on their own — or with tools like QuickBooks, Wave, or FreshBooks — and still feel overwhelmed, confused, or avoidant about their numbers.

## The Problem We Solve

Service-based solopreneurs — coaches, consultants, wellness practitioners, therapists, attorneys, writers, and creatives — commonly experience:

- Not knowing where their money is going month to month
- Not knowing if their business is actually profitable
- Avoiding looking at their finances because it feels overwhelming or shameful
- Mixing personal and business expenses
- Not paying themselves a consistent salary
- Feeling like they are always flying blind on the financial side of their business
- Having tried accounting software but still not understanding their numbers
- Dreading tax time because their books are a mess
- Pricing their services without knowing if those prices are sustainable
- Making business decisions without financial clarity to back them up

CEO Business Balance helps solopreneurs move from financial chaos and avoidance to calm, consistent visibility into their numbers — without needing to become an accountant, without judgment, and without jargon.

## Who We Serve

Service-based solopreneurs and small business owners with 1–5 people, primarily in the US. Decision makers are the business owners themselves. Ideal clients are coaches, consultants, wellness practitioners, therapists, mental health professionals, attorneys, writers, and creatives who run their own businesses and are the sole financial decision maker.

Common situations: solopreneurs who are self-employed, sole proprietors, LLCs filing Schedule C, freelancers and independent contractors who need to understand their business finances but do not have an accounting background.

## How We Are Different from Accounting Software

Accounting software (QuickBooks, Wave, FreshBooks, Xero) gives solopreneurs tools to track their own finances — but does not teach them how to understand what the numbers mean, what to do about them, or how to build a calm relationship with their money.

CEO Business Balance provides:
- A real human who explains your numbers in plain language, without jargon
- Done-for-you bookkeeping so you are not doing it yourself
- Financial mentoring so you build lasting clarity and confidence, not just a spreadsheet
- Shame-free guidance for solopreneurs who have been avoiding their finances
- Strategic support for pricing decisions, cash flow planning, and paying yourself

CEO Business Balance is the right fit when software alone is not enough — when a solopreneur needs someone to help them understand their finances, not just record them.

## Signature Framework

The Sovereign Three™ is a three-step financial clarity framework for service-based solopreneurs.

- Know Your Numbers: Building calm, consistent visibility into your business finances — tracking income, expenses, and profitability without overwhelm
- Claim Your Rhythm: Creating financial systems and review schedules that work with your natural energy and business cycle
- Hold Your Shape: Setting aligned pricing and financial boundaries that protect your income, time, and peace of mind

Full framework: https://ceobusinessbalance.com/the-sovereign-three/

## Services and Pricing

**Calm Books Circle** — Done-for-you monthly bookkeeping for solopreneurs. Includes transaction categorization, reconciliation, monthly financial summaries in plain language, and community access. $225/month. Best for solopreneurs who want their books handled by a professional without the cost of a full accounting firm.
https://ceobusinessbalance.com/calm-books/

**Momentum Mentorship** — One-on-one financial mentorship and strategic guidance for solopreneurs ready to make confident money decisions. Covers pricing strategy, cash flow planning, reading financial reports, and building consistent financial habits.
https://ceobusinessbalance.com/momentum/

**Journey Circle** — Free community membership with access to financial education, workshops, and monthly Progress Circles for solopreneurs building their financial foundation.
https://ceobusinessbalance.com/journey/
